description: Synthetic evaluation set for offline-rag-kit. The corpus and questions were written for this project and are released under the repository's MIT license. Kinds: 'lexical' and 'paraphrase' (English, share some words with the answer); 'hard-paraphrase' (no content word in common with the answer, English or Spanish); 'multilingual' (non-English questions answered in the same language); 'cross-lingual' (question and answer in different languages).
